description: Java class defining REST API endpoints for retrieving Loan states at specific points in time, including methods for GET and POST requests with parameters such as loan ID, external ID, date, and request payloads.

classes.name: LoansPointInTimeApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing endpoints to retrieve loan data at specific points in time, delegating calls to underlying service logic.

methods.name: retrieveLoanPointInTime
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a single loan's state at a specified date, identified by loan ID.

methods.name: retrieveLoanPointInTimeByExternalId
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a single loan's state at a specified date, identified by external ID.

methods.name: retrieveLoansPointInTime
methods.description: Handles POST request to retrieve multiple loans' states at a specific point in time based on search criteria.

methods.name: retrieveLoansPointInTimeByExternalIds
methods.description: Handles POST request to retrieve multiple loans' states at a specific point in time by external IDs.
